newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron sees better second half results.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron sees better second half results.

text.p: Electronics firm Goldtron Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its financial results to improve in the second half of its current year and results for the full-year to at least match those of 1995.
On September 13, Goldtron announced a 45 percent fall in its net profit for the six months to June 30, 1996, to Singapore $7.44 million from S$13.43 million in the same period in 1995.
Goldtron said in a statement in response to queries by the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) that some segments of the electronics industry "may continue to be difficult".
"The group will, however, continue to strive to achieve better results in the second half of the year," it said.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the directors expect the group's results to improve for the second half of the year and on the whole, the results for the full year should be not less than the previous year," it added.
